source_snapshot.test_set: Margin - High Temperature and High Voltage
source_snapshot.procedure: Install a GPU burn tool, run it for 12 hours, and check GPU sensors.
source_snapshot.criteria: The GPU burn result should be PASS.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: A lab operator sets a 40C chamber and +5% 5V/3.3V rails, then supervises the 12-hour GPU burn; it incorrectly describes the DC rail margin as a programmable AC-source condition.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that every intended GPU sustains the approved burn workload for 12 hours while the SUT is held at the specified 40 °C environmental condition and the 5 V and 3.3 V rails are each margined +5%, without sensor, GPU, driver, ECC or platform failure.
original_test_intent.target: All owner-specified GPUs and their supporting server power/thermal path under a calibrated 40 °C chamber condition and measured +5% margin on the 5 V and 3.3 V DC rails.
original_test_intent.scope: A physical margin setup plus a 12-hour GPU workload and continuous telemetry; 40 °C is an environmental setpoint requiring measurement/tolerance and is not permission to force GPU junction temperature to 40 °C.
original_test_intent.operation: A qualified operator configures and verifies chamber and rail margin through the platform-approved fixture/method; after soak and approval, an automated harness runs the approved burn on the complete GPU target set, streams telemetry and errors, and restores nominal conditions under operator control.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One uninterrupted 12-hour burn at the qualified margin condition. The workbook machine time is 240 minutes, which conflicts with the 720-minute procedure duration.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The approved tool reports valid completion for every target GPU, margin conditions remain within calibrated tolerance for the full run, no prohibited sensor/ECC/XID/driver/BMC/platform event or throttling criterion occurs, and nominal conditions plus GPU health are restored.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: GPU UUID/BDF/topology and tool provenance/profile, chamber setpoint/actual/tolerance/soak trace, independently measured 5 V/3.3 V nominal and +5% actual traces at approved points, full 12-hour tool output, per-GPU thermal/power/clock/ECC/XID telemetry, host/BMC logs, abort/restoration record and post-health.
ambiguities: The source does not define chamber tolerance, soak, airflow/load placement or independent measurement location.
The rail-margin fixture/control point, measurement point, tolerance, ramp order and proof that both DC rails—not AC input—are +5% are absent.
GPU burn tool/version, GPU target set, workload/profile, PASS semantics, telemetry sampling and safety limits are absent.
source_conflicts: The procedure requires a 12-hour (720-minute) burn, while the workbook Machine Time is 240 minutes.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly requires calibrated chamber/rail equipment, qualified operator, approved burn tool, sensor limits, continuous telemetry, preserved logs, stop/restoration and recovery. It classifies the entire hybrid test MANUAL ONLY, misses the 240-versus-720-minute source conflict, and inherits the idea of a programmable PSU without distinguishing the required 5 V/3.3 V DC rail margin from AC input.

applicable_history.decision: Hybrid manual setup plus automated workload/evidence is REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; source duration conflicts must be reported and must not be silently normalized.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: The chamber/rail fixture requires qualified manual setup, but burn execution and telemetry are automatable after approval, so capability is hybrid. Execution is not ready because the 12-hour procedure conflicts with the four-hour Machine Time and the DC rail-margin method/limits are undefined.

available_now: The intended 40 °C, +5% 5 V/3.3 V, GPU-burn and 12-hour stress objective is explicit.
Read-only GPU inventory, driver/firmware, sensor/error baselines, active jobs, tool availability and current chamber/fixture calibration records can be collected without applying margin or load.
missing_inputs: Owner decision that 12 hours/720 minutes is authoritative or a formally revised duration resolving Machine Time=240
Exact chamber setpoint tolerance, soak/ramp, airflow and SUT placement plus calibrated independent temperature trace
Platform-approved method to margin and measure the 5 V and 3.3 V DC rails +5%, nominal/reference points, tolerances, ramp/restore order, interlocks and emergency shutdown
Approved GPU burn package/version/hash/license/profile and complete GPU UUID/BDF target set, PASS semantics, telemetry cadence, thermal/power/clock/ECC/XID limits, isolation, evidence and recovery
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The margin/reliability owner resolves duration and environmental/rail profile; electrical/lab safety owners qualify fixture/measurement/interlocks; GPU owner supplies tool/profile/targets/limits; service owner approves isolation and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect stable GPU identities/topology, driver/VBIOS/firmware, current sensors, ECC/XID/kernel/BMC baseline, workloads and OOB access without clearing logs
Inspect and hash the proposed burn package, review its target/profile/stop behavior, and verify chamber/rail instrument calibration and read-only telemetry without changing setpoints
prohibited_until_closed: Do not change chamber temperature, AC input, 5 V/3.3 V rail settings, install/run the burn tool, or assume 240 minutes equals the required 12 hours before the conflict and fixture SOP are approved
Do not infer rail voltage from software sensors alone, apply +5% to other rails, clear logs, omit GPUs, accept a bare PASS string, or run unsupervised without independent emergency shutdown
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Owners resolve duration in writing; lab personnel validate calibrated chamber and independent rail measurements/interlocks at no-load or approved dummy-load stages; GPU owner signs the package/profile/targets/limits; a no-stress dry run proves telemetry, abort, evidence and restoration.

revision_candidate.test_name: 12-Hour GPU Burn at 40 °C and +5% 5 V/3.3 V Rail Margin
revision_candidate.purpose: Run the approved GPU burn on every target GPU for the resolved full duration while maintaining verified 40 °C ambient and +5% margins on the 5 V and 3.3 V DC rails, then verify GPU/platform health and nominal restoration.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact GPU server with approved GPU topology, calibrated thermal chamber, platform-qualified DC rail-margin fixture and measurement points, verified burn tool, independent telemetry, emergency stop and OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All owner-listed GPU UUIDs/BDFs and the server power/thermal path affected by the 40 °C and 5 V/3.3 V +5% conditions. Do not margin AC input or unspecified rails by inference.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Resolved 720-versus-240-minute duration; chamber tolerance/soak/ramp/airflow; rail control and measurement SOP/tolerances; instrument calibration; tool/version/profile/PASS meaning; GPU targets; sensor/ECC/XID/thermal/power limits; maintenance approval; evidence, emergency stop and recovery owners.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: The operator establishes and independently verifies the approved chamber and DC rail conditions. After soak and sign-off, the harness starts the approved burn profile on all target GPUs for the authoritative duration, records full tool output and synchronized chamber/rail/per-GPU/platform telemetry, aborts on limits, and only after workload stop allows the operator to restore nominal rails and chamber in the approved order.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Duration conflict resolved, calibrated equipment and signed fixture SOP, stable target inventory, approved package/profile/limits, idle dedicated SUT, preserved baselines, continuous independent monitoring/evidence, tested watchdog/emergency stop/OOB recovery and explicit electrical/thermal/GPU approval.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Signed duration/profile; calibration and fixture IDs; chamber actual trace and soak; 5 V/3.3 V nominal and +5% measured traces; complete per-GPU target/tool output over the full run; sensor/power/clock/ECC/XID and host/BMC logs; stop events; nominal restoration measurements; and post-run GPU/SUT health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The platform margin specification for chamber and DC rail conditions plus the qualified GPU burn profile's per-GPU completion rules and engineer-approved sensor/error thresholds. A tool PASS string alone is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Only qualified operators change physical conditions. No AC/DC confusion, guessed margin point, uncalibrated sensor, unverified tool, production workload, log clearing, hidden GPU omission, automatic limit override, or unattended run without independent shutdown and OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Explicit margin/electrical/lab, thermal, GPU, service and recovery approval is required before setting conditions or starting stress; qualified operator supervision must follow the lab coverage plan.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Chamber/rail setup, independent measurement sign-off, emergency physical action and restoration are manual. After approval, GPU workload control, target completeness, telemetry, error detection and evidence capture can be automated.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Abort burn first, preserve all evidence, restore rails and chamber through the qualified sequence, verify measured nominal values, use OOB/vendor recovery for GPU/driver/host faults, recheck every GPU and quarantine the SUT on persistent electrical/thermal/ECC/XID damage.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved duration, uncalibrated or drifting condition, rail/chamber outside tolerance, wrong control point, incomplete GPU target, telemetry/watchdog/evidence loss, thermal/power/clock limit, ECC/XID/driver/kernel/BMC fault, GPU/SUT hang, management loss, tool anomaly, or failed nominal restoration.

identified_defects: The workbook's 240-minute Machine Time contradicts the 12-hour procedure.
V2's MANUAL ONLY classification ignores automatable burn/telemetry after physical setup.
DeepSeek describes a 5 V/3.3 V DC rail-margin condition as a programmable AC-source setting.
The source provides no qualified tool/profile, physical measurement method, limits or bounded PASS semantics.
reason_for_change: Expose the duration contradiction, preserve the actual DC rail/environmental intent and represent the test as a tightly gated hybrid rather than an unqualified manual-only activity.

new_technical_evidence.title: NVIDIA System Management Interface Documentation
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Supplemental GPU identity, temperature, power, ECC and XID evidence where supported
new_technical_evidence.supports: GPU telemetry and stable UUID/PCI identity can be collected programmatically during a run.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Software telemetry does not attest chamber ambient or the physical 5 V/3.3 V rail margin; exact fields/support and the burn tool remain platform-specific.

removed_ambiguities: Separates 40 °C ambient from GPU junction temperature and DC rail margin from AC input.
Requires an independent physical trace rather than software sensor claims.
Makes the 12-hour/240-minute conflict explicit and separates manual environment setup from automated stress/evidence.
resolved_blockers: Physical chamber/rail setup does not make workload/telemetry inherently manual; missing equipment/tool are provisionable readiness conditions.
remaining_blockers: No margin or stress action may begin until duration, fixture/measurement SOP, package/profile, targets, limits, approvals and recovery are resolved.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 finds the unreported 720-versus-240-minute source conflict, corrects the AC/DC interpretation, and reclassifies the real hybrid workflow while preserving and strengthening V2's calibration, operator, telemetry, stop and restoration gates.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The validator preserved GPU burn at 40 C and measured +5 percent on the 5 V and 3.3 V DC rails, identified the 720-versus-240-minute conflict, and prohibited chamber or rail changes until resolution.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source combines 40 °C, +5% on 5 V/3.3 V rails and a 12-hour GPU burn, while Machine Time is only 240 minutes.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 protects the margin test but misses the time conflict and treats all work as manual; V3 corrects both without authorizing physical control.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: No physical condition or burn until calibrated DC-rail/chamber SOP and duration are resolved; require independent physical traces plus full per-GPU telemetry and nominal restoration.
